elen: quick postmortem from the quant sweep: we ran q8->q4b profile candidates across model-y and model-z. overall latency/cost improvements look good but model-y q4b shows a quality dip on code-block + longform QA bundles (~7% EM drop on our curated golden).

raj: is the drop uniform or concentrated on certain patterns? code fences? tabbed blocks?

elen: concentrated on code fences and multi-paragraph prompts with inline citations. also discovered our eval harness was normalizing whitespace in answers which hid some span shifts; filed bug #EVAL-329. mike opened a quick fix but we should re-run benches after the harness fix.

mike: harness fix PR #1222 landed in staging. it now preserves answer whitespace for exact-match and performs a secondary fuzzy-match. will trigger backfill.

ivy: for golden hygiene i inspected 200 random failing cases: ~40% are forum-scraped snippets with noisy context, 30% are legitimate paraphrase mismatches, 30% are tokenization/normalization artifacts. propose: prune 80 noisy forum items to holdout, add 150 vetted code+longform samples authored by our editors, and run a semantic cluster de-dup to catch paraphrase collisions.

raj: agree. can we get a selection query for candidate paraphrase clusters?

mike: SQL I used to surface clusters (uses embeddings and a tag for code blocks):

```sql
-- paraphrase cluster seed: code/longform candidates
SELECT s.id, g.id AS golden_id, cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) AS sim, s.tags
FROM staging.samplebank s
JOIN golden.set g ON TRUE
WHERE s.tags @> ARRAY['code','longform']::text[]
AND cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) > 0.86
AND cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) < 0.995
ORDER BY sim DESC
LIMIT 600;
```
